world.title: Infosys sees nearly eightfold jump in new US H-1B employment approvals in FY26
world.summary: Infosys reported a significant increase in new H-1B employment approvals in the United States, with 2,088 approvals in fiscal year 2026, compared to 257 in the previous year. This nearly eightfold rise occurs amid ongoing reviews of visa restrictions in Texas. The surge reflects Infosys's expanding workforce needs in the U.S. technology sector.

world.title: Infosys sees eightfold rise in US H-1B approvals as Texas prepares to change visa policy: Report
world.summary: Infosys reported a significant increase in H-1B approvals in the US, rising from 257 in fiscal year 2025 to 2,088 in fiscal year 2026, an eightfold increase. This surge coincides with Texas considering changes to its visa policy under new leadership. The rise reflects a broader trend in employment opportunities for foreign workers in the technology sector.

world.title: South Korea sends rescued fishermen back to North
world.summary: South Korea has repatriated six of the seven North Korean fishermen rescued from their drifting boat earlier this month. The fishermen crossed the maritime border off the Korean Peninsula’s east coast. The seventh fisherman opted to remain in South Korea, but Pyongyang has not commented on his decision. The incident highlights ongoing tensions between the two Koreas.

business.title: Nvidia Blackwell chips turn up at China site tied to Alice Huang
business.summary: Nvidia's Blackwell semiconductors were found in a Shanghai data center linked to Alice Huang and her company, Megaspeed, which is under US investigation. The Chinese firms involved used the Nvidia equipment as collateral for significant loans from local banks. Ongoing investigations have uncovered connections to various companies associated with the Yangtze River Delta Project, raising concerns about illegal trade practices.

business.title: Hackers breach US Air Force's flagship cloud platform, disrupting operations
business.summary: Hackers have breached the US Air Force's Cloud One platform, disrupting operations and potentially exposing sensitive military data, including personnel and logistics information. The incident raises concerns about security vulnerabilities within the platform. The Air Force is investigating the breach to assess the full impact and implement measures to enhance security and prevent future incidents.

business.title: Palo Alto Networks CEO Nikesh Arora warns AI is making hacking ‘dangerously’ easy, explains how
business.summary: Palo Alto Networks CEO Nikesh Arora has warned that artificial intelligence (AI) is making cyberattacks increasingly easier to carry out. He highlighted that AI tools are enabling hackers to exploit vulnerabilities more effectively, leveraging decades of human knowledge. Arora emphasized the need for heightened cybersecurity measures to counteract the growing threat posed by AI-driven hacking techniques.

technology.title: Apple iPhone 20 Pro said to get titanium frame and ceramic limited edition
technology.summary: Apple is expected to reintroduce a titanium frame for the iPhone 20 Pro (Max) using a new manufacturing process. Additionally, a limited edition model is rumored to feature a ceramic design. This flagship model is anticipated to debut next year, coinciding with the iPhone's 20th anniversary, and may include a display that curves at all four edges.

technology.title: 5 best side missions and where to find them
technology.summary: GTA 6 features a variety of entertaining side missions, including encounters with Bigfoot, unusual strawberry farms, and cryptocurrency stunts. Players can explore diverse locations, from Vice City to Gellhorn, to uncover these unique experiences. The adventures of characters Jason and Lucia enhance the game's narrative, offering players engaging activities beyond the main storyline. Five standout missions are highlighted for exploration.

technology.title: GTA VI: 6 Florida destinations that bring Vice City’s world to life
technology.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI highlights six real Florida locations that inspired its fictional setting, Leonida. Key destinations include Miami Beach, Brickell, Key West, and the Gulf Coast. The game revitalizes interest in Florida's landscapes, showcasing its beaches, cities, and coastal communities. As anticipation builds for the game's release, these locations reflect the vibrant culture and scenery of the Sunshine State.

sports.title: Marc Marquez opens up: These are the reasons behind his MotoGP retirement
sports.summary: Marc Marquez announced his retirement from MotoGP before the Valencia Grand Prix, marking the end of his illustrious career. The ten-time world champion shared his reasons for stepping back two hours after the announcement. The Valencia Grand Prix will be his final race, concluding a record-breaking tenure in the sport that has captivated fans worldwide.

sports.title: Pakistan A vs Bangladesh A LIVE score, Rising Stars Asia Cup 2026 semifinal: BAN 123/5 (32); Sufyan strikes thrice in quick succession
sports.summary: In the Rising Stars Asia Cup 2026 semifinal, Bangladesh A scored 123 runs for 5 wickets in 32 overs against Pakistan A at West End Park International Cricket Stadium, Doha. Sufyan took three wickets in quick succession, including Afif Hossain, who struggled throughout his innings. The match continues with live updates available for fans following the game.

sports.title: Jamie Overton skittles Australia with five as England surge to series lead
sports.summary: England defeated Australia by seven wickets in the first Test at the Gabba, taking a 1-0 lead in the series. Australia struggled with the bat, scoring only 108 runs, with Jamie Overton taking five wickets for 12 runs and Jack Dawson claiming three for 16. England chased down the target, finishing at 93 for 3.

health.title: World AIDS Day 2026: Why Food Is Part Of The Prescription For People Living With HIV
health.summary: On World AIDS Day 2026, experts emphasize the importance of nutrition for individuals living with HIV. While medications are crucial for managing the virus, a balanced diet, including staples like dal, ragi roti, and milk, is essential for maintaining strength and overall health. Dietitians and organizations advocate for integrating food into comprehensive HIV care strategies.

health.title: Genetic analysis of the X chromosome in neurological disorders
health.summary: Research indicates sex differences in neurological disorders, with conditions like Lewy body dementia and autism more common in males, while Alzheimer’s and multiple sclerosis are more prevalent in females. The X chromosome, crucial for immune and brain function, has been underexplored. X chromosome-wide association studies reveal genetic factors influencing disease susceptibility and resilience, aiding in tailored therapeutic strategies.

health.title: Breakthrough drug gives doctors new tool to fight pancreatic cancer
health.summary: A new pancreatic cancer drug, Daraxonrasib, has been administered for the first time in the UAE to a 61-year-old Emirati woman. This development, announced by the Burjeel Cancer Institute at Burjeel Medical City in Abu Dhabi, enhances treatment options for pancreatic cancer, which is known for its high mortality rate. The drug represents a significant advancement in cancer therapy.

science.title: Hera finds a vast crater on asteroid struck by NASA
science.summary: ESA’s Hera spacecraft has discovered a stadium-sized crater on Dimorphos, the asteroid impacted by NASA's DART mission in 2022. The findings include hundreds of previously uncharted boulders. This discovery follows DART's objective to test the capability of altering an asteroid's trajectory. Images released by the European Space Agency illustrate the crater and surrounding features on the asteroid's surface.

science.title: A fossil that still shines. How Indian scientists are uncovering the universe’s ancient past
science.summary: Indian scientists are studying ancient stars, referred to as stellar fossils, to gain insights into the universe's early history. These stars, still shining in space, may reveal how the fundamental components of planets and life were formed. By analyzing these celestial objects, researchers aim to better understand the conditions that existed billions of years ago in the cosmos.

science.title: What Astronauts Ate This Thanksgiving On The International Space Station
science.summary: Astronaut Anil Menon shared a video showcasing the harvesting of wasabi lettuce grown on the International Space Station for Thanksgiving. Celebrating the holiday in space differs from Earth, as astronauts focus on their unique environment. The meal emphasizes gratitude and connection, even in isolation, highlighting the adaptability of traditions like Thanksgiving in the context of space exploration.

entertainment.title: Javed Akhtar says he lost 15 years of his life due to alcohol: 'All the major mistakes that I have made were due to that influence'
entertainment.summary: Veteran screenwriter and lyricist Javed Akhtar discussed his struggles with alcoholism, stating he lost 15 years of his life due to its influence. He emphasized that many of his major mistakes stemmed from drinking. Akhtar, who quit alcohol in 1991, reflected on this challenging period in a recent conversation, highlighting the significant impact it had on his life.

entertainment.title: South Indian Box Office 2026: Telugu Leads the ₹5,308 Crore Net Market but Kollywood Generates Nearly 10 Times Tollywood's Cross-Language Business Within South India
entertainment.summary: In 2026, the South Indian box office analysis shows Telugu cinema leading with a net market of ₹5,308 crore. However, Tamil cinema (Kollywood) significantly outperformed Telugu in cross-language business, generating nearly ten times Tollywood's figures. The study of 807 box office records highlights the impact of cross-industry releases on collections across Telugu, Tamil, Malayalam, and Kannada films.

entertainment.title: Inside Katy Perry, 42, and Justin Trudeau, 54's romantic luxury train journey across Europe
entertainment.summary: Katy Perry shared insights into her European vacation with Justin Trudeau through Instagram posts. The 42-year-old singer showcased their romantic journey aboard a luxury train, highlighting picturesque landscapes and intimate moments. The couple's getaway has attracted attention from fans, offering a glimpse into their relationship. Perry's posts reflect the enjoyment and connection experienced during their travels across Europe.
